recipes.name: BROWNIES
ingredients: 80 –160 ml milk, as needed for consistency
1 1/2 tsp instant espresso powder (optional, enhances chocolate flavor)
instructions: For Cakey Brownies:
For the Cakey Brownies Batter
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) . Line a 9x13 inch/23x33 cm baking pan with parchment paper and grease with vegetable oil. - vegetable oil for greasing

In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, combine the butter and sugar on medium speed until a light and fluffy cream forms. - 500 g granulated sugar - 225 g unsalted butter room temperature

In a separate bowl, whisk together the cocoa powder, kosher salt, and baking powder. Gradually add the dry mixture to the butter and sugar mixture, mixing on low speed until combined. - 125 g unsweetened cocoa powder - 1 tsp kosher salt - 1 tsp baking powder
Add the eggs and egg white one at a time, making sure each is fully incorporated before adding the next.
Add the water and beat the mixture on high speed until creamy.
Slowly add the flour and mix minimally to avoid overmixing. - 190 g all purpose flour
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted off-center comes out clean with a few moist crumbs.
Remove the brownies from the pan using the parchment paper and allow them to cool completely on a wire rack for at least 1 hour.
For the Optional Frosting

Combine the softened butter, powdered sugar, cocoa powder, and enough milk to achieve a spreadable consistency. Frost the brownies once cooled, and add sprinkles if desired. - 113 g unsalted butter softened - 300 g powdered sugar sifted - 45 g cocoa powder - 120 ml –160 ml milk as needed for consistency - sprinkles (optional)
For Chewy, Fudgy Brownies:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13 inch/23x3 cm baking pan (preferably non stick) with parchment paper or aluminum foil, and grease with cooking spray. - vegetable oil for greasing

In a large bowl, combine cocoa powder, espresso powder, chopped unsweetened chocolate, and boiling water. Whisk until everything is melted and smooth. - 35 g unsweetened cocoa powder - 1 ½ tsp instant espresso powder (optional enhances chocolate flavor) - 56 g unsweetened chocolate chopped
While still warm, stir in the butter until melted, followed by the vegetable oil.
Once the mixture has cooled slightly, whisk in the eggs, egg yolks, vanilla extract, and granulated sugar until fully combined. - 1 ½ tsp vanilla extract - 500 g granulated sugar
Add the flour and stir until smooth, then fold in the chopped bittersweet chocolate. - all purpose flour - 170 g bittersweet chocolate chopped
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a tester toothpick inserted in the center comes out with moist crumbs.
For Melty Brownies:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13 inch/23x3 cm baking pan (preferably non stick) with parchment paper and grease with vegetable oil. - vegetable oil for greasing

In a large bowl, whisk together the granulated sugar, melted butter, espresso powder, vanilla extract, eggs, and egg yolks. - 225 g unsalted butter melted - 1 ½ tsp instant espresso powder (optional) - 1 tsp vanilla extract
Stir in the cocoa powder, vegetable oil, and chopped bittersweet chocolate until well combined. - 100 g cocoa powder - 120 ml vegetable oil - 170 g bittersweet chocolate chopped
In a separate bowl, whisk together the bread flour, baking powder, and kosher salt. Gradually add this mixture to the wet ingredients, stirring to combine. - 1 tsp baking powder - 1 tsp kosher salt
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-23 minutes, or until your desired doneness is reached (for melty, gooey brownies, bake on the lower end of the time).
Allow the brownies to cool before slicing. Seve and enjoy!
